bias.en: Neutral turning bearish · back under the 200-day
bias.zh: 中性偏空 · 再度跌破 200 日均线

read.en: Alphabet fell 1.1% on Oct 20 to $340.27 in a $338.36–344.77 range, closing just under the rising 200-day average ($341.2). It is also below the 5-day ($344.4), rising 30-day ($345.0) and 10-day ($347.9) and the falling 100-day ($349.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and is above zero with the histogram widening, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($358.60), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月20日下跌 1.1%，收于 $340.27，盘中区间 $338.36–344.77，收盘略低于上行的 200 日均线（$341.2）。股价同时位于 5 日（$344.4）、上行的 30 日（$345.0）和 10 日（$347.9）及下行的 100 日均线（$349.9）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$358.60），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The 200-day average was lost again on the close, and the low undercut the $339.1 Oct 16 low. Resistance is $341.2 (200-day), then $344–345 (5 and 30-day) and $348–350 (10 and 100-day). Support is $338.4 (Oct 20 low), then $335.5 (Oct 1 low) and $327.7 (Sep 10 low). A close below $335.5 would open $327.7; a close above $345 would target $350.
read.zh: 200 日均线在收盘时再度失守，盘中低点跌破 $339.1 的 10月16日低点。阻力为 $341.2（200 日均线），其次 $344–345（5 日和 30 日均线）和 $348–350（10 日和 100 日均线）。支撑为 $338.4（10月20日低点），其次 $335.5（10月1日低点）和 $327.7（9月10日低点）。若收盘跌破 $335.5，下一目标看 $327.7；若收盘站上 $345，下一目标看 $350。
